        .issue(&IssueRequest {
            ttl_hours: 1,
            label: "Responses WebSocket unit client",
            account: Some("primary"),
            max_tokens,
            client_kind: Some(ClientKind::Codex.canonical_name()),
            principal_id: Some("primary"),
            ..IssueRequest::default()
        })
        .expect("issue bound client token")
}
